title: 第1626章 老将之活第1625章 职业大融合
content_zh:
比如，在索西亚，你是【铁匠】，在部落，你是【锻造师】。
在完成前两个阶段后，你已经是一名出色的【高级锻造匠师】【高级锻造技术员】。
但真正融合和，你的整个职业可能会发生彻底的异变，变成一种融合了彼此技术、文化、底蕴的全新职业，比如【流水魔锻匠师】【宫廷传承匠师】【野战术补匠师】。
这个时候，名字可以预见，将会变得千奇百怪。
职业名称，堪比“称号”，甚至比一些称号还要花哨。
想要进行分类，就只能从基础的开始进行。
只能根据他们最原始的性质，方向来定义。
部落由此，未雨绸缪，制定了一套新的职业框架体系。
排除特殊职业、超凡职业、特殊职业、复融合职业等。
将最基础的部落发展职业重新构架。
采用四级分层划分，层级数量清晰区分：
第一层：门类（20个，最高层级大行业）
农林牧渔
采矿业
制造业
城网业
建筑业
批发零售业
交运仓储邮政业
旅宿餐饮业

信息业
金融业
土地业
租服业
科研业
环境业
民协业
教育业
卫社业
文体业
公管业
异组业
有人要问了，为啥没有军队、民兵、药师之类相关的？
那些最基础的职业，也都跟超凡沾边了，没办法按照纯粹的“根性发展职业”关联了。
content_en:
For example, in Sosia, you are a [blacksmith], and in the tribe, you are a [blacksmith].
After completing the first two stages, you are already an outstanding [Senior Blacksmith] [Senior Blacksmith Technician].
But with true integration, your entire profession may undergo a complete change and become a brand new profession that integrates each other's technology, culture, and heritage, such as [Flowing Water Demon Blacksmith] [Palace Heritage Craftsman] [Wild Tactics Tinker].
At this time, the names can predictably become all kinds of weird.
A professional name is comparable to a "title", even more fancy than some titles.
If you want to classify, you can only start from the basics.
can only be defined according to their most original nature, direction.
The tribe thus prepared for a rainy day and formulated a new career framework system.
Exclude special professions, extraordinary professions, special professions, complex fusion professions, etc.
Restructure the most basic tribe development profession.
Four levels of stratification are used, and the number of levels is clearly distinguished:
The first level: Categories (20, the highest level of major industries)
Agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery
mining industry
Manufacturing
City network industry
construction industry
Wholesale and retail industry
Delivery, Warehousing and Postal Industry
Travel, accommodation and catering industry
Information industry
financial industry
land industry
Rental service industry
Scientific research industry
environmental industry
ADPL
Education industry
Health and Social Industry
Culture and sports industry
Public administration industry
heterogeneous industry
Some people may ask, why are there no military, militia, pharmacists, etc.?
The most basic professions are all related to the extraordinary, and there is no way to purely "development of professions based on their roots".
